name: nexus
description: Nexus Skill 1.1 for long-term memory extraction, retrieval, injection, feedback, maintenance, shared local SQLite configuration, and Obsidian-friendly Markdown export.

interface.shortDescription: Long-term memory skill with Obsidian export
interface.longDescription: Use Nexus to configure a shared local SQLite memory store, detect reusable existing data, extract durable memories from task context, search prior decisions and preferences, inject relevant memories into the current workflow, record feedback, maintain the memory store, and export memory into Obsidian-friendly Markdown.
defaultPrompt: Help me configure Nexus storage paths, inspect whether existing memory data can be reused, and use long-term memory in this workflow.
